tour.accountBody: Sign in with Google or GitHub to keep your hosts in your account, or protect the app with a second factor.
tour.hostsBody: Your hosts live here, grouped. Click one to connect, or add your own with the + button.
tour.languageBody: You can change it later in Settings. The rest of the tour will be shown in the language you pick.
tour.readyBody: That is it. Press Ctrl+K for the command palette and find any action. You can watch this tour again from Help.
tour.statusBody: Here you can see the fps, your hosts, the open sessions and the transfer queue.
tour.tabsBody: Every connection is a tab, so you can have several open at once.
tour.viewsBody: Switch between the terminal, the files and Pixel Agents from here.
tour.welcomeBody: A desktop SSH and SFTP client. Let me show you the essentials in a few seconds, and you can leave whenever you want.
